filename_tr: 文法の葉 — ハズム・フンフール.epub
description: This book provides an in-depth exploration of Arabic grammar, covering fundamental concepts such as parts of speech (nouns, verbs, particles), inflection types, and noun/verb states. It details plural forms, rules for imperfect verbs, and the distinction between definite and indefinite nouns, offering a thorough understanding of the language's structure.
